results.prompt: Show me 25 available books at Smith College with title and barcode

response.sql:
SELECT
  inst.title,
  ii.barcode
FROM inventory.item__t AS ii
JOIN inventory.holdings_record__t AS hr
  ON ii.holdings_record_id = hr.id
JOIN inventory.instance__t AS inst
  ON hr.instance_id = inst.id
JOIN inventory.material_type__t AS imt
  ON ii.material_type_id = imt.id
JOIN inventory.location__t AS loc
  ON ii.effective_location_id = loc.id
JOIN inventory.loclibrary__t AS lib
  ON loc.library_id = lib.id
JOIN inventory.loccampus__t AS camp
  ON lib.campus_id = camp.id
WHERE
  ii.status__name = 'Available' AND LOWER(imt.name) = 'book' AND LOWER(camp.name) = LOWER('Smith College')
LIMIT 25;
response.explanation:
This query retrieves the title and barcode for 25 available items classified as 'Book' located at Smith College. It joins item records with holdings, instances, material types, and the location hierarchy to filter by availability, material type, and campus.

DATA SOURCE: folio

results.prompt: How many open loans do we currently have by campus?

response.sql:
SELECT
  camp.name AS campus_name,
  COUNT(cl.id) AS open_loan_count
FROM circulation.loan__t AS cl
JOIN inventory.item__t AS ii
  ON cl.item_id = ii.id
JOIN inventory.location__t AS loc
  ON ii.effective_location_id = loc.id
JOIN inventory.loclibrary__t AS lib
  ON loc.library_id = lib.id
JOIN inventory.loccampus__t AS camp
  ON lib.campus_id = camp.id
WHERE
  cl.status__name = 'Open'
GROUP BY
  camp.name
ORDER BY
  open_loan_count DESC
LIMIT 100;
response.explanation:
This query counts the number of currently open loans by joining loan records to item records, then through the location hierarchy (location, library, campus) to get the campus name. It filters for loans with a status of 'Open' and groups the results by campus name.

DATA SOURCE: folio
